sentences.en: I am happy to read and write every day.
We listen to music and speak about travel.
The weather in this city is nice.

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: I want to travel to a big city.
turns.zh: 我想去一座大城市旅行。

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: That sounds happy. The weather there is nice too.
turns.zh: 听起来很开心。那里天气也不错。

readings.title: A Happy Trip
readings.body: Last summer, I traveled to a big city. The weather was nice. I listened to music on the train and read a book. In the city, I spoke with new friends. We talked about dreams and music. I wrote about the trip in my book. It was a happy journey, and I want to travel again.

writing_prompts.question: The ___ in this city is nice.
用 dream 和 travel 写一句话。
